messages.subject: Call R script from Java
messages.body_plain:
Hi Renjin Team

I have a R script which is perfectly running but when is used with Renjin there are compatibility issues,
1. There is no equivalent library(varComp) available.
Should i need to write new package and use it?

2.
aModel_M <- aov(COLUMN1 ~ COLUMN2, data=data)
hsdModel_M <- TukeyHSD(aModel_M)
Error,
        org.renjin.eval.EvalException: no terms component nor attribute

at org.renjin.primitives.R$primitive$stop.doApply(R$primitive$stop.java from WrapperSource:72)
at org.renjin.primitives.R$primitive$stop.apply(R$primitive$stop.java from WrapperSource:33)
at org.renjin.primitives.special.InternalFunction.apply(InternalFunction.java:55)
at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluateCall(Context.java:261)
at org.renjin.eval.Context.evaluate(Context.java:193)

-Thiru

messages.body_plain:
Not all GNU R functions are implemented in Renjin. write.table() is one of them and there's an issue open for it which provides a workaround: https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/issues/49

Maarten-Jan

Regarding the error with the date formatting: there is an issue in GitHub that may help you get started, it is #109 <https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/issues/109>.

Good luck!

Maarten-Jan
